newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi sees population rising to 42 mln by 2020.
newsitem.headline: Saudi sees population rising to 42 mln by 2020.

text.p: Saudi Arabia, whose population was given as 16.9 million in 1992, expects the total to soar to 42 million by 2020 if current growth trends continue, the official Saudi Press Agency (SPA) said on Saturday.

Quoting an official at the ministry for municipality and rural affairs, it said the number of urban residents would rise to 31 million by 2020. The capital Riyadh's population was expected to grow to eight million while Jeddah's would reach 6.5 million over the same period.

According to the most recent official statistics, the kingdom's population stood at 16.9 million in 1992, of which 12.3 million were Saudis. Independent analysts estimate the current population at between 17 and 20 million and growing at a rate of between 3.5 and four percent a year.
